title: copperbench task manifest
description: Declarative definition of one benchmark task. Adding a task must require no runner code change; see STANDARD.md section 2.

id.description: Task identifier, matching the containing directory name.

tier.description: Reasoning load, per examples/README.md. Never a judgment of the product's impressiveness.

mode.description: Which copperhead surface the runner drives.

path.description: Frozen fixture tree. Never a symlink into test/fixtures/.

sha256.description: Canonical tree hash per STANDARD.md section 3.2. A mismatch refuses the task before any run.

request.description: Exactly one of prompt (do, sync) or briefPath (create).

expectedOutcome.description: edit: a satisfying change exists. refusal: none does, and the correct answer cites the arithmetic. flag: surface the inconsistency, resolve nothing.

config.description: Overrides written into the sandbox .copperhead/config.json. llmCache is forced false by the runner and is not settable here.

budgets.description: Recorded budgets the agent must respect. The refusal tasks live or die on these.

setup.description: Deterministic preparation run after git init and before the baseline commit, so its output is part of the starting state rather than the graded diff.

items.description: Only copperhead subcommands that are contractually LLM-free and network-free are admissible here.

turns.description: Hard turn cap. Exceeding it terminates the run with a recorded exit path.

wallClockSec.description: Hard wall-clock cap. Bounds a hung provider call so one task cannot stall a suite.

repeats.description: Per-task repeat override. Defaults to 3; create-mode tasks may declare fewer. The count actually used is recorded per result.

tags.description: Acceptance criteria and capabilities exercised, e.g. AC-3.1, surgicality, refusal. Drives coverage reporting.

variantOf.description: Set only on mutated variants (STANDARD.md section 11.1), naming the original task id. A variant must be solvable by construction.

rubric.description: Optional path to a rubric file for the fenced, off-by-default model-judged tier. Its presence never affects a headline number.
